item.title: Northern Railway’s Jammu division marks first year with series of historic milestones
item.description: Jammu: Northern Railway’s Jammu division, which is completing its first year next week, achieved several historic milestones in infrastructure development, connectivity and operational expansion, officials said on Sunday. item.title: 1.59 lakh registrations recorded under Mission YUVA across J&K
item.description: Jammu: More than 1.59 lakh registrations were recorded under Mission YUVA in the past six months with 44,857 proposals approved and loans worth Rs 756.28 crore sanctioned in Jammu and Kashmir, officials said on Sunday. item.title: BJP MLAs holds meeting ahead of J-K Assembly’s Budget Session
item.description: Jammu: BJP MLAs in Jammu and Kashmir attended a meeting here on Sunday, discussing key political, organisational and public issues ahead of the Budget session of the Assembly that will begin on February 2. item.title: Cold wave hits Jammu, dense fog alert issued; Valley freezes
item.description: Jammu: As winter intensifies across Jammu and Kashmir, authorities have issued fresh advisories warning of cold wave conditions, dense fog in Jammu plains, and sub-zero temperatures in Kashmir, even as weather activity remains largely dry for the coming days. In the Jammu division, officials have cautioned commuters about moderate to dense fog likely over the next three days, particularly during early morning and late evening hours. item.title: MHA shuffles 49 IAS, IPS officers; 7 moved out of J&K, 9 posted in UT
item.description: JAMMU: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) has ordered a major reshuffle of All India Services officers, transferring several IAS and IPS officers of the AGMUT cadre with immediate effect. The latest round of transfers has brought significant changes in the administrative and policing setup of the Union Territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. item.title: Indus, Chenab rivers will be utilised solely for country, says Manohar Lal
item.description: Jammu: Union Power Minister Manohar Lal on Sunday issued a firm message to Pakistan, saying that no objections from Islamabad will be entertained over India’s hydropower projects in the Indus and Chenab river basins, asserting that the country’s water resources will be utilised exclusively for the benefit of India and its people. item.title: PM Modi likely to inaugurate Leh Airport Terminal in April
item.description: Leh, Jan 6: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is likely to visit Leh in April to inaugurate the new terminal building of Leh Airport along with a set of key strategic and civilian infrastructure projects in the Union Territory of Ladakh, according to official sources. item.title: Snow blocks Mughal Road, Clearance operations underway
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 6: The historic Mughal Road continues to remain closed for vehicular traffic following overnight snowfall in the higher reaches, officials said on Tuesday. The closure comes amid renewed winter activity that has led to significant snow accumulation along the vital inter-district road connecting south Kashmir with the Pir Panjal region.
